observation: The assistant prepared the candidate packet first and only then discovered that the live CURRENT/Organism Supabase control plane was unreachable from the connected SQL transport (ECONNREFUSED). The human then explicitly redirected the process to learn from blockers in the assistant's own work, not only blockers encountered by workers.
missed_pattern: The autonomy test audited future worker dependencies but did not first audit the assistant/operator execution path itself for known prerequisites, transport health, and likely blocking transitions.
discovered_pattern: Before promising or sequencing a material next step, the acting shell should run a bounded SELF_EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT: identify the exact external/control-plane transitions it will need, test the earliest critical dependency first, and either use an existing degraded-owner fallback or persist a truthful boundary before doing downstream preparation that depends on it.
broader_opportunity: Treat friction in Guide/assistant/operator work as first-class learning evidence, using the same turning-point schema as worker/human interactions. This can expose hidden dependencies before they become human-visible stalls.

human_redirect_event.before_state: META-AUTONOMY-01 packet prepared; routing deferred after encountering control-plane failure.
human_redirect_event.human_redirect_summary: Do the routing work, record why the blocker was not anticipated, and make the assistant more self-critical about obstacles in its own execution.
human_redirect_event.assumption_broken: The preparation flow implicitly treated control-plane availability as a later concern instead of a prerequisite to the promised launch handoff.
human_redirect_event.trajectory_delta: Add self-execution blocker preflight and operator-friction learning before routing/launch claims.
human_redirect_event.avoidable_by_existing_capability: PARTIAL: preflight/degraded-owner rules already existed in UNIVERSAL_SESSION_PREFLIGHT_V1, but were not applied early enough to this materialization path.

question_evolution_candidate.proposed_companion: Antes de comprometer el siguiente paso, ¿qué transición externa o herramienta crítica necesita mi propio trabajo para completarlo, ya comprobé que está disponible y cuál es el fallback durable si falla?
question_evolution_candidate.reason: Q02 detects hidden dependencies generally, but this version forces the acting shell to audit its own execution path before downstream work.

steps: Name the exact material transition promised next.
List the minimal external/tool/control-plane dependencies required.
Probe the earliest critical dependency first.
If live owner is degraded, use only an existing sanctioned fallback; never invent a parallel authority.
If no sanctioned fallback can perform the material transition, persist a boundary plus exact resume condition before additional dependent work.
Record the blocker as learning evidence and question delta.
self_execution_preflight_candidate.non_goal: Do not turn preflight into broad health checking or recursive planning.
